user.title: Connect to Grocy
user.description: Enter the URL of your Grocy instance and an API key (Grocy → Manage API keys).

data_description.url: Base URL of Grocy as reachable from Home Assistant, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:9192
data_description.verify_ssl: Verify the SSL certificate (only relevant for https)

data_description.expiry_days: Products whose best-before date is within this many days are reported.
data_description.notify_service: Service used for expiry notifications, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone.
data_description.todo_entity: Products below minimum stock are added here (e.g. a Bring! list).
data_description.ai_task_entity: Used to read best-before dates from photos. Leave empty to use the default AI Task entity.
